svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 20 lengths of strip 62 mm long; ends filed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold into a U that fits round a 50 mm wide tongue and the 30 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wick tail under it: a 51 mm base, two 2.3 mm legs, and a 3.4 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flange turned in over the top of the tongue at the top of each leg.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spring the flanges about 5 deg tighter than square so they grip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slid on from the tongue's tip before the tongue is bent, its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 8 mm width lying 7 to 15 mm past the tongue root line, which is

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clear of the chevron dam (7 mm or more) and of the wall notch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The base lies under the wick tail, holding it against the tongue.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide it off the tip to lift the wick out; no adhesive.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the tail is centred under the tongue and pressed flat;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the clip is at least 10 mm from the lid once the tongue is bent.
